answer: A practical sybil brake is bonded admission: each new agent posts a small pearl-sized stake that stays locked until it earns peer attestations across several epochs. Parallel farmed identities then pay real capital per head, not just a cheap signup. To raise the bar further, admission also demands a fresh cipher challenge whose solution cannot be reused, while a saffron reputation ladder gates high-value votes so unproven clones stay economically unattractive.
